title: AutoRefine: Auto-Calibrating Code Judges from Workflow Outcomes
title_zh: AutoRefine：从工作流结果自动校准代码评审判官

paragraphs.en: AutoRefine利用工作流结果标签自动校准代码评审判官，并随系统演进持续重新校准。 LLM judges increasingly serve as quality gates for code changes that have no test oracle, but a judge prompt must be calibrated for its task and recalibrated as the system it judges evolves, while hand labels for the calibration are resource intensive and go stale. Development workflows emit outcome labels for free (tests pass or fail, changes land or are abandoned), but these labels are noisy. We present AutoRefine, a loop that rewrites a deployable judge's prompt to reproduce outcome labels, with an informed teacher that sees the judge's input plus the outcome, explains each label it keeps, and abstains when the outcome cannot be explained from what the judge sees. On a held-out dataset with an execution oracle, calibration raised chance-corrected agreement (Scott's $π$) from 0.36 to 0.60. On a deployed agent's outcome labels, with 25\% flipped at random to introduce noise, the teacher set aside flipped \textsc{fail} labels at more than twice the rate of genuine ones, cutting overall label noise from 25\% to 20\%. Recalibrating that agent's judge using AutoRefine raised its agreement with merge/abandon outcomes on 17 independently held-out diffs from the current workflow ($π$ 0.16 to 0.51); on 16 diffs from older workflows, the previous judge stayed ahead, illustrating the need for recalibration as the agent evolves. By abstaining, the teacher not only removes noisy labels but also flags changes whose outcome the judge's input cannot explain, telling a team when a judge needs better inputs rather than a better prompt.
paragraphs.zh: AutoRefine 利用工作流结果标签自动校准代码评审判官，并随系统演进持续重新校准。LLM 判官日益充当没有测试基准（test oracle）的代码变更的质量关卡，但判官的提示词必须针对其任务进行校准，并随着它所评判的系统演进而重新校准，而用于校准的人工标注既耗费资源又会过时。 开发工作流免费产生结果标签（测试通过或失败、变更合入或被放弃），但这些标签是有噪声的。 我们提出 AutoRefine，这是一个循环，它重写一个可部署判官的提示词以复现结果标签，并配备一个知情教师，该教师能看到判官的输入加上结果，解释其保留的每个标签，并在无法从判官所见的内容解释结果时弃权。 在一个带有执行基准（execution oracle）的留出数据集上，校准将经机会校正的一致性（Scott's $\pi$）从 0.36 提升到 0.60。 在一个已部署智能体的结果标签上，随机翻转 25\% 的标签以引入噪声，教师搁置被翻转的 \textsc{FAIL} 标签的比率是真实标签的两倍以上，将整体标签噪声从 25\% 降至 20\%。 使用 AutoRefine 重新校准该智能体的判官，使其在来自当前工作流的 17 个独立留出 diff 上与合入/放弃结果的一致性得到提升（$\pi$ 从 0.16 到 0.51）；而在来自更早工作流的 16 个 diff 上，旧判官仍然更胜一筹，这说明了随着智能体演进而重新校准的必要性。 通过弃权，教师不仅去除了有噪声的标签，还标记出那些判官输入无法解释其结果的变更，从而告诉团队何时判官需要的是更好的输入而非更好的提示词。
